Metadata.title: SurShongi — Your voice. Their strings. One song.
Metadata.description: A home for musicians in Bangladesh to find each other and collaborate remotely. Vocals, guitar, tabla, mixing, and everything in between.

Pwa.install: Add SurShongi to your home screen
Pwa.notify: Ping this phone when a new message arrives

Stream.title: Sample tracks
Stream.note: Previews of the player. Real profiles come next.

How.title: Three steps
How.sub: Find someone, talk it through, and trade the files — in one place.

steps.title: Open a profile
steps.body: Your name, your city, and what you do. YouTube and audio samples can come later.

steps.title: Send a request
steps.body: What you need, the genre, and the timing. Add a reference track if you have one.

steps.title: Talk, then take the song
steps.body: Terms stay in the thread. The finished track comes back there.

Guide.title: How it works
Guide.sub: Every option below opens that part of SurShongi, so you can see it and use it.

ask.title: Ask for someone
ask.body: Write the voice, the city, or the instrument you need. Ask uses the same search as the box at the top of the home page.

hire.title: Hire a player or a whole stage
hire.body: Home starts with a stage agency, then singers, guitar, tabla, and the other skills. Tap a card to see who offers it.

agency.title: Join as a stage agency
agency.body: An agency offers the full show: band, sound, lights, and the performance. This opens the join form on that choice. A profile that is already finished keeps its current type.

musician.title: Join as a musician
musician.body: Add what you play, a starting price, and a sample. People can hire you from search and from your profile.

member.title: Join without being a musician
member.body: A regular member can browse, follow, and message. Instruments, a price, and a showcase are not required.

prefs.title: Choose what you see first
prefs.body: On the home feed, turn on the skills and genres you want at the top. The chip changes immediately, and the green bar shows while it saves.

follow.title: Follow musicians
follow.body: Follow someone from a post, the directory, or their profile. Their posts collect under Following.

post.title: Post an offer or a part you need
post.body: Write what you are offering, or the part you are looking for. You can add a price, a YouTube link, or audio.

messages.title: Message someone
messages.body: The green messages button stays in the corner of the screen. When you are signed in, this opens your conversation list.

orders.title: Place an order and follow it
orders.body: From a chat you can place an order and note the bKash TrxID you already confirmed in your own app. The orders page lists what you sent and what you received.

editor.title: Cut and mix a song
editor.body: Upload audio, trim it, and shape the mix. The same cutter works on a phone.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Visitors see your samples and links. You change photos, social links, and YouTube from the profile when you choose edit.

Paths.title: Start from either side
Paths.sub: One account can hold more than one role. For now, see which door is yours.
Paths.vocalistBody: Guitar, bass, tabla, mixing — find the person and send a request. Your vocal sample goes along as the reference.
Paths.instrumentBody: Build a profile with samples and video. Your city, starting price, and turnaround stay up front.

Roles.title: Any musician
Roles.sub: Guitar is one example. Voice, tabla, dotara, production, lyrics — same door.

items.title: Vocalist
items.body: Sing, then find the player the song is missing.

items.title: Guitarist
items.body: Rhythm, solo, acoustic — strings around someone else's voice.

items.title: Other instrumentalist
items.body: Violin, flute, keys, tabla, dhol, dotara.

items.title: Producer / engineer
items.body: Beats, recording, mix — get the song standing.

items.title: Lyricist / composer
items.body: Words, melody, and the shape of the song.

Close.title: One song, two people.
Close.sub: Like a late-night studio — low light, clear work.

Footer.blurb: A place for musicians in Bangladesh to work together.

Editor.title: Multitrack Studio
Editor.sub: Line up takes on one shared timeline, trim, split and fade clips, balance the mix, record over it, then export a WAV or send it to a musician.

Editor.dropHint: Drop audio files anywhere on this page, or use Import audio. WAV, MP3, M4A, OGG.
Editor.noSelection: Select a clip to edit its exact position, trim, gain and fades.
Editor.shortcuts: Space play/pause · S split at playhead · Delete remove clip · Ctrl+D duplicate · Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo · L loop · Home start. Drag a clip to move it (also to another track), drag its edges to trim, drag the small top corners to fade. Drag on the ruler to set a loop. Double-click a slider to reset it.

Orders.title: Orders
Orders.intro: Every order you placed or received. A bKash TrxID counts only after the seller confirms that same ID in their own bKash app. SurShongi does not take or send the money.
Orders.empty: No orders on this side yet.
Orders.signIn: Sign in to see your orders.
Orders.trxHint: 6 to 20 letters or numbers, as shown in the bKash app.
Orders.noneBuyer: Pay the musician from your bKash app, then paste the TrxID here. The seller confirms it before the payment is treated as checked.
Orders.noneSeller: The buyer has not saved a bKash TrxID yet.
Orders.submittedBuyer: Saved. It stays unchecked until the seller confirms this exact ID in their bKash app.
Orders.submittedSeller: Open your bKash app and check this TrxID against the payment you received. Confirm only if it matches.
Orders.confirmed: Checked. The seller confirmed this TrxID. It is locked and cannot be changed.
Orders.disputed: The seller did not confirm this TrxID. The buyer can submit a corrected ID.
